title: fix: separate agent run time from slow chat-send preparation
body:
## What Problem This Solves

A steer send acknowledged in 51 ms later logged `slow chat send 476459ms stage=steer ... preparation=476386ms`, even though most of that interval was a full agent turn. This sent operators looking for a roughly 476-second preparation stall that had not occurred.

## User Impact

Operators can distinguish prepared-reply execution from preparation in slow chat-send logs and diagnostic events. This changes diagnostics only; acknowledgement, admission, dispatch, steering, and behavior-controlling timings remain unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing dispatch timing scope remains in `preparation` while `reply.run_prepared_reply` runs. The diagnostics owner now switches that scope to `run` for the existing span and back to `dispatch` afterward. Detail spans retain their inclusive durations, and startup/queued diagnostics still stop at their existing boundaries. The logging guide documents the boundary and `chat.send.run` event.

The simplification pass retained the existing owners and removed no execution machinery. The necessary growth is 18 production lines and 66 test lines, covering the reported attribution bug, structured event, and startup/queued cutoff contracts.

## Evidence

The clock-controlled diagnostics regression failed on base `af50b8e6ee1d8`: a 476382 ms prepared reply yielded `preparation=476416ms` and no `run`. With this fix it reports `preparation=14ms`, `run=476382ms`, `dispatch=20ms`, and emits `chat.send.run` with the same duration. Detail-span durations remain intact.

All 49 tests across chat-send diagnostics, startup timing, prestart steering, direct followup, auto-reply dispatch, and dispatcher settlement passed (6 files; 237.00 s command wall time, including cold compiler/setup work). The changed diagnostics file independently passed all 15 tests (63.63 s command wall time, 49.63 s Vitest duration; test bodies 1–29 ms). Exact-head CI run 44244110068 attempt 1 completed with two participant-custody assertion failures; all other jobs passed or were skipped. The failed file reproduced locally (142 passed, 2 failed; 460.73 s). Both failing cases also reproduce with the original production diagnostics restored from base (42.56 s); their owner/authority inputs are unchanged in the CI merge. The native inherited-failure route retains CI as failed and verifies security and review gates independently.

Targeted Gateway-methods typecheck passed in 3.7 s. Targeted Oxlint, formatting for all three files, and `git diff --check` passed. Isolated Codex autoreview of the complete local change against `af50b8e6ee1d8`, through P2, was scoped-clean with no actionable findings. The subsequent pr-simplify pass required no changes.

The supplied production observation was the only production evidence used; no live-server access was needed.
